items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Tightens Chip Tracking In Southeast Asia
items.summary: Nvidia (NasdaqGS:NVDA) is tightening chip tracking in Southeast Asia to address smuggling concerns linked to China and rising US scrutiny. US lawmakers are pushing for a briefing from Nvidia's CEO on the firm's controls and due diligence over restricted chip flows. Mexico's Fermaca has launched an Nvidia powered AI factory platform as the country's first NVIDIA Cloud Partner offering for Latin America.
